text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The strongest Umamusume has been<n>decided.
Symboli Rudolf basks in the<n>crowd's applause as
she holds her<n>title high. Next up: the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Narita Brian, who was<n>watching the
race, comes by the<n>waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Their terse conversation ends with<n>some pointed
remarks from Brian<n>about Rudolf's insistence on
keeping<n>up her student council duties.
